verses.textZh: 在犹大王约坦、亚哈斯、希西家执政的时候，耶和华的话临到摩利沙人弥迦，是他看到关于撒玛利亚和耶路撒冷的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在犹大王约坦、亚哈斯、希西家执政的时候，耶和华的话临到摩利沙人弥迦，是他看到关于撒玛利亚和耶路撒冷的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 当犹大王约坦、亚哈斯、希西家在位的时候，摩利沙人弥迦得耶和华的默示，论撒马利亚和耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—the vision he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave this message to Micah of Moresheth during the years when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah. The visions he saw concerned both Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord which came to Micah of Moresheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and which he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord that came to Micah of Moresheth during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah—the vision he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 万民哪！你们都要听； 地和地上所遍满的，你们要聆听； 主耶和华要指证你们的不是， 主必从他的圣殿指证你们的不是。
verses.textZhCnvs: 万民哪！你们都要听； 地和地上所遍满的，你们要聆听； 主耶和华要指证你们的不是， 主必从他的圣殿指证你们的不是。
verses.textZhCuv: 万民哪，你们都要听！ 地和其上所有的，也都要侧耳而听！ 主耶和华从他的圣殿 要见证你们的不是。
verses.textEnNiv: Hear, you peoples, all of you, listen, earth and all who live in it, that the Sovereign Lord may bear witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, you peoples, all of you; pay attention, O earth, and all that is in it, and let the Lord God be a witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, all you peoples! Listen, O earth, and all that is in it! Let the Lord God be a witness against you, The Lord from His holy temple.
verses.textEnNlt: Attention! Let all the people of the world listen! Let the earth and everything in it hear. The Sovereign Lord is making accusations against you; the Lord speaks from his holy Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear, you peoples, all of you; Listen carefully, earth and all it contains, And may the Lord God be a witness against you, The Lord from His holy temple.
verses.textEn: Hear, you peoples, all of you, listen, earth and all who live in it, that the Sovereign Lord may bear witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

verses.textZh: 看哪！耶和华离开自己的地方， 他降下来，踏在地的高处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！耶和华离开自己的地方， 他降下来，踏在地的高处。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，耶和华出了他的居所， 降临步行地的高处。
verses.textEnNiv: Look! The Lord is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads on the heights of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, the Lord is coming out of his place, and will come down and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For behold, the Lord is coming out of His place; He will come down And tread on the high places of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Look! The Lord is coming! He leaves his throne in heaven and tramples the heights of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: For behold, the Lord is coming forth from His place. He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
verses.textEn: Look! The Lord is coming from his dwelling place; he comes down and treads on the heights of the earth.

verses.textZh: 群山在他脚下融化， 众谷裂开， 如蜡在火前一般， 像水冲下斜坡一般，
verses.textZhCnvs: 群山在他脚下融化， 众谷裂开， 如蜡在火前一般， 像水冲下斜坡一般，
verses.textZhCuv: 众山在他以下必消化， 诸谷必崩裂， 如蜡化在火中， 如水冲下山坡。
verses.textEnNiv: The mountains melt beneath him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.
verses.textEnEsv: And the mountains will melt under him, and the valleys will split open, like wax before the fire, like waters poured down a steep place.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mountains will melt under Him, And the valleys will split Like wax before the fire, Like waters poured down a steep place.
verses.textEnNlt: The mountains melt beneath his feet and flow into the valleys like wax in a fire, like water pouring down a hill.
verses.textEnNasb: The mountains will melt under Him And the valleys will be split, Like wax before the fire, Like water poured down a steep place.
verses.textEn: The mountains melt beneath him and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like water rushing down a slope.

verses.textZh: 这都是因为雅各的过犯， 以色列家的罪恶。 雅各的过犯是甚么呢？ 不就是撒玛利亚吗？ 犹大家的罪恶是甚么呢？ 不就是耶路撒冷吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是因为雅各的过犯， 以色列家的罪恶。 雅各的过犯是甚么呢？ 不就是撒玛利亚吗？ 犹大家的罪恶是甚么呢？ 不就是耶路撒冷吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这都因雅各的罪过， 以色列家的罪恶。 雅各的罪过在哪里呢？ 岂不是在撒马利亚吗？ 犹大的邱坛在哪里呢？ 岂不是在耶路撒冷吗？
verses.textEnNiv: All this is because of Jacob’s transgression, because of the sins of the people of Israel. What is Jacob’s transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah’s high place? Is it not Jerusalem?
verses.textEnEsv: All this is for the transgression of Jacob and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what is the high place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNkjv: All this is for the transgression of Jacob And for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Isit not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Arethey not Jerusalem?
verses.textEnNlt: And why is this happening? Because of the rebellion of Israel — yes, the sins of the whole nation. Who is to blame for Israel’s rebellion? Samaria, its capital city! Where is the center of idolatry in Judah? In Jerusalem, its capital!
verses.textEnNasb: All this is due to the wrongdoing of Jacob And the sins of the house of Israel. What is the wrongdoing of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? What is the high place of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
verses.textEn: All this is because of Jacob’s transgression, because of the sins of the people of Israel. What is Jacob’s transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah’s high place? Is it not Jerusalem?

verses.textZh: 所以我必使撒玛利亚变成田间的废堆， 作栽种葡萄之处； 我必把撒玛利亚的石头倒在谷中， 连它的根基都露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我必使撒玛利亚变成田间的废堆， 作栽种葡萄之处； 我必把撒玛利亚的石头倒在谷中， 连它的根基都露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我必使撒马利亚变为田野的乱堆， 又作为种葡萄之处； 也必将她的石头倒在谷中， 露出根基来。
verses.textEnNiv: "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap in the open country, a place for planting vineyards, and I will pour down her stones into the valley and uncover her foundations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the field, Places for planting a vineyard; I will pour down her stones into the valley, And I will uncover her foundations.
verses.textEnNlt: "So I, the Lord , will make the city of Samaria a heap of ruins. Her streets will be plowed up for planting vineyards. I will roll the stones of her walls into the valley below, exposing her foundations.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will make Samaria a heap of ruins in the open country, Planting places for a vineyard. I will hurl her stones down into the valley, And lay bare her foundations.
verses.textEn: "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.

verses.textZh: 它一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎； 它全部的钱财，都要用火烧尽； 它所有的偶像，我都要毁灭； 因为从妓女钱财榨取的， 最后也必归为妓女的钱财。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎； 它全部的钱财，都要用火烧尽； 它所有的偶像，我都要毁灭； 因为从妓女钱财榨取的， 最后也必归为妓女的钱财。
verses.textZhCuv: 她一切雕刻的偶像必被打碎； 她所得的财物必被火烧； 所有的偶像我必毁灭； 因为是从妓女雇价所聚来的， 后必归为妓女的雇价。
verses.textEnNiv: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used."
verses.textEnEsv: All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, all her wages shall be burned with fire, and all her idols I will lay waste, for from the fee of a prostitute she gathered them, and to the fee of a prostitute they shall return.
verses.textEnNkjv: All her carved images shall be beaten to pieces, And all her pay as a harlot shall be burned with the fire; All her idols I will lay desolate, For she gathered it from the pay of a harlot, And they shall return to the pay of a harlot."
verses.textEnNlt: All her carved images will be smashed. All her sacred treasures will be burned. These things were bought with the money earned by her prostitution, and they will now be carried away to pay prostitutes elsewhere."
verses.textEnNasb: All of her idols will be crushed, All of her earnings will be burned with fire, And all of her images I will make desolate; For she collected them from a prostitute’s earnings, And to the earnings of a prostitute they will return.
verses.textEn: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used."

verses.textZh: 为此我要痛哭哀号， 赤膊光脚而行； 又要哀号如豺狼， 悲鸣像鸵鸟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为此我要痛哭哀号， 赤膊光脚而行； 又要哀号如豺狼， 悲鸣像鸵鸟。
verses.textZhCuv: 先知说：因此我必大声哀号， 赤脚露体而行； 又要呼号如野狗， 哀鸣如鸵鸟。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.
verses.textEnEsv: For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will make lamentation like the jackals, and mourning like the ostriches.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals And a mourning like the ostriches,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I will mourn and lament. I will walk around barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of this I must mourn and wail, I must go barefoot and naked; I must do mourning like the jackals, And a mourning like the ostriches.
verses.textEn: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.

verses.textZh: 因为撒玛利亚的创伤无法医治， 并且殃及犹大， 直逼我子民的城门， 就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为撒玛利亚的创伤无法医治， 并且殃及犹大， 直逼我子民的城门， 就是耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为撒马利亚的伤痕无法医治， 延及犹大和耶路撒冷我民的城门。
verses.textEnNiv: For Samaria’s plague is incurable; it has spread to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.
verses.textEnEsv: For her wound is incurable, and it has come to Judah; it has reached to the gate of my people, to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: For her wounds are incurable. For it has come to Judah; It has come to the gate of My people— To Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: For my people’s wound is too deep to heal. It has reached into Judah, even to the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For her wound is incurable, For it has come to Judah; It has reached the gate of my people, Even to Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: For Samaria’s plague is incurable; it has spread to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.

verses.textZh: 不要在迦特报信， 不要在巴歌哭泣； 却要在伯．亚弗拉打滚于尘土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要在迦特报信， 不要在巴歌哭泣； 却要在伯．亚弗拉打滚于尘土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要在迦特报告这事， 总不要哭泣； 我在伯‧亚弗拉滚于灰尘之中。
verses.textEnNiv: Tell it not in Gath ; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrah roll in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all; in Beth-le-aphrah roll yourselves in the dust.
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell it not in Gath, Weep not at all; In Beth Aphrah Roll yourself in the dust.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t tell our enemies in Gath ; don’t weep at all. You people in Beth-leaphrah, roll in the dust to show your despair.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not tell it in Gath, Do not weep at all. At Beth-le-aphrah roll yourself in the dust in mourning.
verses.textEn: Tell it not in Gath ; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrah roll in the dust.

verses.textZh: 沙斐的居民哪！你们赤身羞愧走过去吧。 撒南的居民不敢出来 ； 伯．以薛人的哀号，要把你们立足之地夺去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙斐的居民哪！你们赤身羞愧走过去吧。 撒南的居民不敢出来 ； 伯．以薛人的哀号，要把你们立足之地夺去。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙斐的居民哪，你们要赤身蒙羞过去。 撒南的居民不敢出来。 伯‧以薛人的哀哭使你们无处可站。
verses.textEnNiv: Pass by naked and in shame, you who live in Shaphir. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; it no longer protects you.
verses.textEnEsv: Pass on your way, inhabitants of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame; the inhabitants of Zaanan do not come out; the lamentation of Beth-ezel shall take away from you its standing place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pass by in naked shame, you inhabitant of Shaphir; The inhabitant of Zaanan does not go out. Beth Ezel mourns; Its place to stand is taken away from you.
verses.textEnNlt: You people in Shaphir, go as captives into exile—naked and ashamed. The people of Zaanan dare not come outside their walls. The people of Beth-ezel mourn, for their house has no support.
verses.textEnNasb: Go on your way, inhabitant of Shaphir, in shameful nakedness. The inhabitant of Zaanan does not escape. The mourning of Beth-ezel: "He will take from you its support."
verses.textEn: Pass by naked and in shame, you who live in Shaphir. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; it no longer protects you.

verses.textZh: 玛律的居民， 急待得着幸福， 因有灾祸从耶和华那里降下， 临到耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛律的居民， 急待得着幸福， 因有灾祸从耶和华那里降下， 临到耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛律的居民心甚忧急，切望得好处， 因为灾祸从耶和华那里临到耶路撒冷的城门。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the Lord , even to the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: For the inhabitants of Maroth wait anxiously for good, because disaster has come down from the Lord to the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the inhabitant of Maroth pined for good, But disaster came down from the Lord To the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Maroth anxiously wait for relief, but only bitterness awaits them as the Lord ’s judgment reaches even to the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For the inhabitant of Maroth Waits for something good, Because a disaster has come down from the Lord To the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the Lord , even to the gate of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 拉吉的居民哪！ 要用快马套车， 这就是锡安子民 罪恶的开端； 因为以色列的过犯， 都在你那里找到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉吉的居民哪！ 要用快马套车， 这就是锡安子民 罪恶的开端； 因为以色列的过犯， 都在你那里找到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉吉的居民哪，要用快马套车； 锡安民 的罪由你而起； 以色列人的罪过在你那里显出。
verses.textEnNiv: You who live in Lachish, harness fast horses to the chariot. You are where the sin of Daughter Zion began, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
verses.textEnEsv: Harness the steeds to the chariots, inhabitants of Lachish; it was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion, for in you were found the transgressions of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: O inhabitant of Lachish, Harness the chariot to the swift steeds (She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion), For the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
verses.textEnNlt: Harness your chariot horses and flee, you people of Lachish. You were the first city in Judah to follow Israel in her rebellion, and you led Jerusalem into sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Harness the chariot to the team of horses, You inhabitant of Lachish— She was the beginning of sin To the daughter of Zion— Because in you were found The rebellious acts of Israel.
verses.textEn: You who live in Lachish, harness fast horses to the chariot. You are where the sin of Daughter Zion began, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

verses.textZh: 因此要把妆奁， 送给摩利设．迦特； 亚革悉的各家， 必用诡诈对待以色列的众王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此要把妆奁， 送给摩利设．迦特； 亚革悉的各家， 必用诡诈对待以色列的众王。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大啊，你要将礼物送给摩利设‧迦特。 亚革悉的众族必用诡诈待以色列诸王。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Akzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you shall give parting gifts to Moresheth-gath; the houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you shall give presents to Moresheth Gath; The houses of Achzib shallbe a lie to the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Send farewell gifts to Moresheth-gath ; there is no hope of saving it. The town of Aczib has deceived the kings of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you will give parting gifts In behalf of Moresheth-gath; The houses of Achzib will become a deception To the kings of Israel.
verses.textEn: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Akzib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.

verses.textZh: 玛利沙的居民哪！ 我要再使那征服你的来到你那里； 以色列的荣耀，必去到亚杜兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛利沙的居民哪！ 我要再使那征服你的来到你那里； 以色列的荣耀，必去到亚杜兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛利沙的居民哪， 我必使那夺取你的来到你这里； 以色列的尊贵人 必到亚杜兰。
verses.textEnNiv: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. The nobles of Israel will flee to Adullam.
verses.textEnEsv: I will again bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah; the glory of Israel shall come to Adullam.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will yet bring an heir to you, O inhabitant of Mareshah; The glory of Israel shall come to Adullam.
verses.textEnNlt: O people of Mareshah, I will bring a conqueror to capture your town. And the leaders of Israel will go to Adullam.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, I will bring on you The one who takes possession, You inhabitant of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will enter Adullam.
verses.textEn: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. The nobles of Israel will flee to Adullam.

verses.textZh: 犹大啊！为你所喜爱的儿女， 你要剃头，使你的头光秃， 完全光秃如同秃鹰； 因为他们都从你那里被掳去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大啊！为你所喜爱的儿女， 你要剃头，使你的头光秃， 完全光秃如同秃鹰； 因为他们都从你那里被掳去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大啊，要为你所喜爱的儿女剪除你的头发， 使头光秃，要大大地光秃，如同秃鹰， 因为他们都被掳去离开你。
verses.textEnNiv: Shave your head in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourself as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.
verses.textEnEsv: Make yourselves bald and cut off your hair, for the children of your delight; make yourselves as bald as the eagle, for they shall go from you into exile.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make yourself bald and cut off your hair, Because of your precious children; Enlarge your baldness like an eagle, For they shall go from you into captivity.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, people of Judah, shave your heads in sorrow, for the children you love will be snatched away. Make yourselves as bald as a vulture, for your little ones will be exiled to distant lands.
verses.textEnNasb: Shave yourself bald, yes, cut off your hair, Because of the children of your delight; Extend your baldness like the eagle, For they will go from you into exile.
verses.textEn: Shave your head in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourself as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.

verses.textZh: 那些在床上图谋不义， 并且行恶的人有祸了！ 因为他们的手有力量， 天一亮，就作出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些在床上图谋不义， 并且行恶的人有祸了！ 因为他们的手有力量， 天一亮，就作出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 祸哉，那些在床上图谋罪孽、造作奸恶的！ 天一发亮，因手有能力就行出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to those who devise wickedness and work evil on their beds! When the morning dawns, they perform it, because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to those who devise iniquity, And work out evil on their beds! At morning light they practice it, Because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits you who lie awake at night, thinking up evil plans. You rise at dawn and hurry to carry them out, simply because you have the power to do so.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to those who devise wrongdoing, Who practice evil on their beds! When morning comes, they do it, Because it is in the power of their hands.
verses.textEn: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning’s light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.

verses.textZh: 他们要田地，就去抢夺； 想要房屋，就去强取。 他们欺压人和他的家眷， 取人和人的产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们要田地，就去抢夺； 想要房屋，就去强取。 他们欺压人和他的家眷， 取人和人的产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们贪图田地就占据， 贪图房屋便夺取； 他们欺压人，霸占房屋和产业。
verses.textEnNiv: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them. They defraud people of their homes, they rob them of their inheritance.
verses.textEnEsv: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them away; they oppress a man and his house, a man and his inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: They covet fields and take them by violence, Also houses, and seize them. So they oppress a man and his house, A man and his inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: When you want a piece of land, you find a way to seize it. When you want someone’s house, you take it by fraud and violence. You cheat a man of his property, stealing his family’s inheritance.
verses.textEnNasb: They covet fields, so they seize them; And houses, so they take them. They exploit a man and his house, A person and his inheritance.
verses.textEn: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them. They defraud people of their homes, they rob them of their inheritance.

verses.textZh: 因此耶和华这样说： 看哪！我策划灾祸攻击这家族， 你们无法缩起颈项避开这灾祸。 你们不能昂首而行 ； 因为这是个灾难的时代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此耶和华这样说： 看哪！我策划灾祸攻击这家族， 你们无法缩起颈项避开这灾祸。 你们不能昂首而行 ； 因为这是个灾难的时代。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华如此说： 我筹划灾祸降与这族； 这祸在你们的颈项上不能解脱； 你们也不能昂首而行， 因为这时势是恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, the Lord says: "I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore thus says the Lord : behold, against this family I am devising disaster, from which you cannot remove your necks, and you shall not walk haughtily, for it will be a time of disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Behold, against this family I am devising disaster, From which you cannot remove your necks; Nor shall you walk haughtily, For this is an evil time.
verses.textEnNlt: But this is what the Lord says: "I will reward your evil with evil; you won’t be able to pull your neck out of the noose. You will no longer walk around proudly, for it will be a terrible time."
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore this is what the Lord says: "Behold, I am planning against this family a catastrophe From which you cannot remove your necks; And you will not walk haughtily, For it will be an evil time.
verses.textEn: Therefore, the Lord says: "I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

verses.textZh: 到那日，必有人作歌讽刺你们， 唱悲伤的哀歌，说： "我们彻底被毁灭了， 我子民分内的产业，他竟转给别人了； 他怎可从我这里挪去， 把我们的田地分给掳掠我们的人 ！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，必有人作歌讽刺你们， 唱悲伤的哀歌，说： "我们彻底被毁灭了， 我子民分内的产业，他竟转给别人了； 他怎可从我这里挪去， 把我们的田地分给掳掠我们的人 ！"
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，必有人向你们提起悲惨的哀歌， 讥刺说：我们全然败落了！ 耶和华将我们的分转归别人， 何竟使这分离开我们？ 他将我们的田地分给悖逆的人。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day people will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: ‘We are utterly ruined; my people’s possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: In that day they shall take up a taunt song against you and moan bitterly, and say, "We are utterly ruined; he changes the portion of my people; how he removes it from me! To an apostate he allots our fields."
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day one shall take up a proverb against you, And lament with a bitter lamentation, saying: ‘We are utterly destroyed! He has changed the heritage of my people; How He has removed it from me! To a turncoat He has divided our fields.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: In that day your enemies will make fun of you by singing this song of despair about you: "We are finished, completely ruined! God has confiscated our land, taking it from us. He has given our fields to those who betrayed us. "
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day they will take up against you a song of mocking And utter a song of mourning and say, ‘We are completely destroyed! He exchanges the share of my people; How He removes it from me! To the apostate He apportions our fields.’
verses.textEn: In that day people will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: ‘We are utterly ruined; my people’s possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.’ "

verses.textZh: 因此你在耶和华的会众中， 必没有抽签拉准绳的人了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你在耶和华的会众中， 必没有抽签拉准绳的人了。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以在耶和华的会中， 你必没有人拈阄拉准绳。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the Lord to divide the land by lot.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you will have none to cast the line by lot in the assembly of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you will have no one to determine boundaries by lot In the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Others will set your boundaries then, and the Lord ’s people will have no say in how the land is divided.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore you will have no one applying a measuring line For you by lot in the assembly of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the Lord to divide the land by lot.

verses.textZh: 有人预言说："你们不要说预言； 人不可预言这些事； 羞耻不会临到我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人预言说："你们不要说预言； 人不可预言这些事； 羞耻不会临到我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们 说：你们不可说预言； 不可向这些人说预言， 不住地羞辱我们。
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not prophesy," their prophets say. "Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us."
verses.textEnEsv: "Do not preach"—thus they preach— "one should not preach of such things; disgrace will not overtake us."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Do not prattle," yousaytothose who prophesy. So they shall not prophesy to you; They shall not return insult for insult.
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t say such things," the people respond. "Don’t prophesy like that. Such disasters will never come our way!"
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Do not prophesy,’ so they prophesy. But if they do not prophesy about these things, Insults will not be turned back.
verses.textEn: "Do not prophesy," their prophets say. "Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us."

verses.textZh: 雅各家啊！人怎可说： "耶和华的心着急 ，不能忍耐呢？ 这些是他的作为吗？" 我耶和华的话对行事正直的人不是有益的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家啊！人怎可说： "耶和华的心着急 ，不能忍耐呢？ 这些是他的作为吗？" 我耶和华的话对行事正直的人不是有益的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家啊，岂可说耶和华的心不忍耐吗 ？ 这些事是他所行的吗？ 我－耶和华的言语岂不是与行动正直的人有益吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You descendants of Jacob, should it be said, "Does the Lord become impatient? Does he do such things?" "Do not my words do good to the one whose ways are upright?
verses.textEnEsv: Should this be said, O house of Jacob? Has the Lord grown impatient? Are these his deeds? Do not my words do good to him who walks uprightly?
verses.textEnNkjv: Youwhoare named the house of Jacob: "Is the Spirit of the Lord restricted? Are these His doings? Do not My words do good To him who walks uprightly?
verses.textEnNlt: Should you talk that way, O family of Israel? Will the Lord ’s Spirit have patience with such behavior? If you would do what is right, you would find my words comforting.
verses.textEnNasb: "Is it being said, house of Jacob: ‘Is the Spirit of the Lord impatient? Are these His works?’ Do My words not do good For the one walking rightly?
verses.textEn: You descendants of Jacob, should it be said, "Does the Lord become impatient? Does he do such things?" "Do not my words do good to the one whose ways are upright?

verses.textZh: 你们却像仇敌一样，起来攻击我的子民 ； 你们竟从安详过路的人身上剥去衣服， 从不愿作战的人身上剥去外衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们却像仇敌一样，起来攻击我的子民 ； 你们竟从安详过路的人身上剥去衣服， 从不愿作战的人身上剥去外衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，近来我的民兴起如仇敌， 从那些安然经过不愿打仗之人身上剥去外衣。
verses.textEnNiv: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.
verses.textEnEsv: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy; you strip the rich robe from those who pass by trustingly with no thought of war.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lately My people have risen up as an enemy— You pull off the robe with the garment From those who trust you, as they pass by, Like men returned from war.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet to this very hour my people rise against me like an enemy! You steal the shirts right off the backs of those who trusted you, making them as ragged as men returning from battle.
verses.textEnNasb: " Recently My people have arisen as an enemy— You strip the robe off the garment From unsuspecting passers-by, From those returned from war.
verses.textEn: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.

verses.textZh: 你们把我民中的妇女赶逐， 离开欢乐的家园； 你们把我的尊荣，从她们的婴孩身上夺去， 直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们把我民中的妇女赶逐， 离开欢乐的家园； 你们把我的尊荣，从她们的婴孩身上夺去， 直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们将我民中的妇人从安乐家中赶出， 又将我的荣耀从她们的小孩子尽行夺去。
verses.textEnNiv: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.
verses.textEnEsv: The women of my people you drive out from their delightful houses; from their young children you take away my splendor forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: The women of My people you cast out From their pleasant houses; From their children You have taken away My glory forever.
verses.textEnNlt: You have evicted women from their pleasant homes and forever stripped their children of all that God would give them.
verses.textEnNasb: "You evict the women of My people, Each one from her pleasant house. From her children you take My splendor forever.
verses.textEn: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.

verses.textZh: 起来，走吧！ 这不是你们安息之地； 你们因为不洁净的缘故， 必被毁灭， 是不可挽救的毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 起来，走吧！ 这不是你们安息之地； 你们因为不洁净的缘故， 必被毁灭， 是不可挽救的毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们起来去吧！ 这不是你们安息之所； 因为污秽使人 毁灭， 而且大大毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise and go, for this is no place to rest, because of uncleanness that destroys with a grievous destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise and depart, For this is not your rest; Because it is defiled, it shall destroy, Yes, with utter destruction.
verses.textEnNlt: Up! Begone! This is no longer your land and home, for you have filled it with sin and ruined it completely.
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise and go, For this is no place of rest Because of the uncleanness that brings on destruction, A painful destruction.
verses.textEn: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.

verses.textZh: 若有人随从虚假的心， 撒谎说： "我要向你们说清酒和烈酒的预言。" 那人就是这民的预言家了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 若有人随从虚假的心， 撒谎说： "我要向你们说清酒和烈酒的预言。" 那人就是这民的预言家了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有人心存虚假，用谎言说： 我要向你们预言得清酒和浓酒。 那人就必作这民的先知。
verses.textEnNiv: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, ‘I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,’ that would be just the prophet for this people!
verses.textEnEsv: If a man should go about and utter wind and lies, saying, "I will preach to you of wine and strong drink," he would be the preacher for this people!
verses.textEnNkjv: If a man should walk in a false spirit And speak a lie, saying, ‘I will prophesy to you of wine and drink,’ Even he would be the prattler of this people.
verses.textEnNlt: Suppose a prophet full of lies would say to you, "I’ll preach to you the joys of wine and alcohol!" That’s just the kind of prophet you would like!
verses.textEnNasb: "If someone walking after wind and falsehood Had lied and said, ‘I will prophesy to you about wine and liquor,’ He would become a prophet to this people.
verses.textEn: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, ‘I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,’ that would be just the prophet for this people!

verses.textZh: 雅各家啊！我必召集你们所有的人， 聚集以色列的余民； 我要把他们安置在一起， 像羊在羊圈里， 像群羊远离了人，在草场上喧哗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家啊！我必召集你们所有的人， 聚集以色列的余民； 我要把他们安置在一起， 像羊在羊圈里， 像群羊远离了人，在草场上喧哗。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家啊，我必要聚集你们， 必要招聚以色列剩下的人， 安置在一处，如波斯拉的羊， 又如草场上的羊群； 因为人数众多就必大大喧哗。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.
verses.textEnEsv: I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob; I will gather the remnant of Israel; I will set them together like sheep in a fold, like a flock in its pasture, a noisy multitude of men.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will surely assemble all of you, O Jacob, I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together like sheep of the fold, Like a flock in the midst of their pasture; They shall make a loud noise because of somany people.
verses.textEnNlt: "Someday, O Israel, I will gather you; I will gather the remnant who are left. I will bring you together again like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture. Yes, your land will again be filled with noisy crowds!
verses.textEnNasb: "I will certainly assemble all of you, Jacob, I will certainly gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together like sheep in the fold; Like a flock in the midst of its pasture They will be noisy with people.
verses.textEn: "I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.

verses.textZh: 开路的人领先上去； 他们开路，闯门进入，又从门里出来； 他们的王在他们面前走过， 耶和华领导他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 开路的人领先上去； 他们开路，闯门进入，又从门里出来； 他们的王在他们面前走过， 耶和华领导他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 开路的 在他们前面上去； 他们直闯过城门，从城门出去。 他们的王在前面行； 耶和华引导他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their King will pass through before them, the Lord at their head."
verses.textEnEsv: He who opens the breach goes up before them; they break through and pass the gate, going out by it. Their king passes on before them, the Lord at their head.
verses.textEnNkjv: The one who breaks open will come up before them; They will break out, Pass through the gate, And go out by it; Their king will pass before them, With the Lord at their head."
verses.textEnNlt: Your leader will break out and lead you out of exile, out through the gates of the enemy cities, back to your own land. Your king will lead you; the Lord himself will guide you."
verses.textEnNasb: "The one who breaks through goes up before them; They break through, pass through the gate, and go out by it. So their king passes on before them, And the Lord at their head."
verses.textEn: The One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their King will pass through before them, the Lord at their head."

verses.textZh: 我说： "雅各的首领，你们要听， 以色列家的官长，你们也要听； 难道你们不知道公平吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说： "雅各的首领，你们要听， 以色列家的官长，你们也要听； 难道你们不知道公平吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：雅各的首领， 以色列家的官长啊，你们要听！ 你们不当知道公平吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then I said, "Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel. Should you not embrace justice,
verses.textEnEsv: And I said: Hear, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel! Is it not for you to know justice?—
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said: "Hear now, O heads of Jacob, And you rulers of the house of Israel: Isit not for you to know justice?
verses.textEnNlt: I said, "Listen, you leaders of Israel! You are supposed to know right from wrong,
verses.textEnNasb: And I said, "Hear now, you leaders of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know justice?
verses.textEn: Then I said, "Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel. Should you not embrace justice,

verses.textZh: 然而，你们恨恶良善，喜爱邪恶， 从人身上剥皮， 从人骨头上剔肉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，你们恨恶良善，喜爱邪恶， 从人身上剥皮， 从人骨头上剔肉。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们恶善好恶， 从人身上剥皮， 从人骨头上剔肉，
verses.textEnNiv: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;
verses.textEnEsv: you who hate the good and love the evil, who tear the skin from off my people and their flesh from off their bones,
verses.textEnNkjv: You who hate good and love evil; Who strip the skin from My people, And the flesh from their bones;
verses.textEnNlt: but you are the very ones who hate good and love evil. You skin my people alive and tear the flesh from their bones.
verses.textEnNasb: "You who hate good and love evil, Who tear off their skin from them And their flesh from their bones,
verses.textEn: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;

verses.textZh: 你们吃我民的肉， 剥他们的皮， 打断他们的骨头， 切成像锅里的块， 像釜中的肉块。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们吃我民的肉， 剥他们的皮， 打断他们的骨头， 切成像锅里的块， 像釜中的肉块。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃我民的肉， 剥他们的皮， 打折他们的骨头， 分成块子像要下锅， 又像釜中的肉。
verses.textEnNiv: who eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?"
verses.textEnEsv: who eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones in pieces and chop them up like meat in a pot, like flesh in a cauldron.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who also eat the flesh of My people, Flay their skin from them, Break their bones, And chop them in pieces Like meat for the pot, Like flesh in the caldron."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, you eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin, and break their bones. You chop them up like meat for the cooking pot.
verses.textEnNasb: Who eat the flesh of my people, Strip off their skin from them, Smash their bones, And chop them up as for the pot, And as meat in a cauldron!"
verses.textEn: who eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?"

verses.textZh: 那时，他们要向耶和华呼求， 耶和华却不应允他们。 到那时，耶和华必掩面不顾他们， 因为他们行了恶事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，他们要向耶和华呼求， 耶和华却不应允他们。 到那时，耶和华必掩面不顾他们， 因为他们行了恶事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了遭灾的时候， 这些人必哀求耶和华， 他却不应允他们。 那时他必照他们所行的恶事向他们掩面。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they will cry out to the Lord , but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they will cry to the Lord , but he will not answer them; he will hide his face from them at that time, because they have made their deeds evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they will cry to the Lord, But He will not hear them; He will even hide His face from them at that time, Because they have been evil in their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: Then you beg the Lord for help in times of trouble! Do you really expect him to answer? After all the evil you have done, he won’t even look at you!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they will cry out to the Lord, But He will not answer them. Instead, He will hide His face from them at that time Because they have practiced evil deeds.
verses.textEn: Then they will cry out to the Lord , but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.

verses.textZh: 关于那些使我民走迷路的先知， 耶和华这样说： "他们的牙齿有所咀嚼的时候， 就大叫‘平安’； 谁不把食物给他们吃， 他们就攻击那人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于那些使我民走迷路的先知， 耶和华这样说： "他们的牙齿有所咀嚼的时候， 就大叫‘平安’； 谁不把食物给他们吃， 他们就攻击那人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 论到使我民走差路的先知－ 他们牙齿有所嚼的， 他们就呼喊说：平安了！ 凡不供给他们吃的， 他们就预备攻击他 － 耶和华如此说：
verses.textEnNiv: This is what the Lord says: "As for the prophets who lead my people astray, they proclaim ‘peace’ if they have something to eat, but prepare to wage war against anyone who refuses to feed them.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who lead my people astray, who cry "Peace" when they have something to eat, but declare war against him who puts nothing into their mouths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus says the Lord concerning the prophets Who make my people stray; Who chant "Peace" While they chew with their teeth, But who prepare war against him Who puts nothing into their mouths:
verses.textEnNlt: This is what the Lord says: "You false prophets are leading my people astray! You promise peace for those who give you food, but you declare war on those who refuse to feed you.
verses.textEnNasb: This is what the Lord says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray: When they have something to bite with their teeth, They cry out, "Peace!" But against him who puts nothing in their mouths They declare holy war.
verses.textEn: This is what the Lord says: "As for the prophets who lead my people astray, they proclaim ‘peace’ if they have something to eat, but prepare to wage war against anyone who refuses to feed them.

verses.textZh: 因此你们只有黑夜，没有异象， 只有黑暗，没有默示。 对先知，日头要下落， 为他们，白日变为黑暗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此你们只有黑夜，没有异象， 只有黑暗，没有默示。 对先知，日头要下落， 为他们，白日变为黑暗。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们必遭遇黑夜，以致不见异象； 又必遭遇幽暗，以致不能占卜。 日头必向你们沉落， 白昼变为黑暗。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore it shall be night to you, without vision, and darkness to you, without divination. The sun shall go down on the prophets, and the day shall be black over them;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore you shall have night without vision, And you shall have darkness without divination; The sun shall go down on the prophets, And the day shall be dark for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the night will close around you, cutting off all your visions. Darkness will cover you, putting an end to your predictions. The sun will set for you prophets, and your day will come to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it will be night for you—without vision, And darkness for you—without divination. The sun will go down on the prophets, And the day will become dark over them.
verses.textEn: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.

verses.textZh: 先见必抱愧， 得默示的人要蒙羞； 他们都必掩着上唇， 因为没有神的答复。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先见必抱愧， 得默示的人要蒙羞； 他们都必掩着上唇， 因为没有神的答复。
verses.textZhCuv: 先见必抱愧， 占卜的必蒙羞， 都必捂着嘴唇， 因为神不应允他们。
verses.textEnNiv: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God."
verses.textEnEsv: the seers shall be disgraced, and the diviners put to shame; they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the seers shall be ashamed, And the diviners abashed; Indeed they shall all cover their lips; For thereis no answer from God."
verses.textEnNlt: Then you seers will be put to shame, and you fortune-tellers will be disgraced. And you will cover your faces because there is no answer from God."
verses.textEnNasb: The seers will be put to shame, And the diviners will be ashamed. Indeed, they will all cover their lips Because there is no answer from God.
verses.textEn: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God."

verses.textZh: 至于我，我却借着耶和华的灵， 满有力量、公平和能力， 可以向雅各述说他的过犯， 向以色列指出他的罪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我却借着耶和华的灵， 满有力量、公平和能力， 可以向雅各述说他的过犯， 向以色列指出他的罪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我藉耶和华的灵， 满有力量、公平、才能， 可以向雅各说明他的过犯， 向以色列指出他的罪恶。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the Lord , and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the Lord , and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But truly I am full of power by the Spirit of the Lord, And of justice and might, To declare to Jacob his transgression And to Israel his sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for me, I am filled with power— with the Spirit of the Lord . I am filled with justice and strength to boldly declare Israel’s sin and rebellion.
verses.textEnNasb: On the other hand, I am filled with power— With the Spirit of the Lord— And with justice and courage To make known to Jacob his rebellious act, And to Israel his sin.
verses.textEn: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the Lord , and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.

verses.textZh: 雅各家的首领，你们要听这个， 以色列家的官长，你们也要听； 你们厌恶公平， 屈枉正直，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各家的首领，你们要听这个， 以色列家的官长，你们也要听； 你们厌恶公平， 屈枉正直，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各家的首领、以色列家的官长啊， 当听我的话！ 你们厌恶公平， 在一切事上屈枉正直；
verses.textEnNiv: Hear this, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;
verses.textEnEsv: Hear this, you heads of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who detest justice and make crooked all that is straight,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now hear this, You heads of the house of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel, Who abhor justice And pervert all equity,
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to me, you leaders of Israel! You hate justice and twist all that is right.
verses.textEnNasb: Now hear this, you heads of the house of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel, Who despise justice And twist everything that is straight,
verses.textEn: Hear this, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;

verses.textZh: 用人血建锡安， 以罪孽造耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 用人血建锡安， 以罪孽造耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 以人血建立锡安， 以罪孽建造耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.
verses.textEnEsv: who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who build up Zion with bloodshed And Jerusalem with iniquity:
verses.textEnNlt: You are building Jerusalem on a foundation of murder and corruption.
verses.textEnNasb: Who build Zion with bloodshed, And Jerusalem with malice.
verses.textEn: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

verses.textZh: 城中的首领为贿赂而审判， 祭司为薪俸而教导， 先知为银子说默示， 他们竟倚靠耶和华，说： "耶和华不是在我们中间吗？ 灾祸必不会临到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中的首领为贿赂而审判， 祭司为薪俸而教导， 先知为银子说默示， 他们竟倚靠耶和华，说： "耶和华不是在我们中间吗？ 灾祸必不会临到我们身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 首领为贿赂行审判； 祭司为雇价施训诲； 先知为银钱行占卜。 他们却倚赖耶和华，说： 耶和华不是在我们中间吗？ 灾祸必不临到我们。
verses.textEnNiv: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they look for the Lord ’s support and say, "Is not the Lord among us? No disaster will come upon us."
verses.textEnEsv: Its heads give judgment for a bribe; its priests teach for a price; its prophets practice divination for money; yet they lean on the Lord and say, "Is not the Lord in the midst of us? No disaster shall come upon us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Her heads judge for a bribe, Her priests teach for pay, And her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the Lord, and say, "Is not the Lord among us? No harm can come upon us."
verses.textEnNlt: You rulers make decisions based on bribes; you priests teach God’s laws only for a price; you prophets won’t prophesy unless you are paid. Yet all of you claim to depend on the Lord . "No harm can come to us," you say, "for the Lord is here among us."
verses.textEnNasb: Her leaders pronounce judgment for a bribe, Her priests teach for pay, And her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the Lord, saying, "Is the Lord not in our midst? Catastrophe will not come upon us."
verses.textEn: Her leaders judge for a bribe, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money. Yet they look for the Lord ’s support and say, "Is not the Lord among us? No disaster will come upon us."

verses.textZh: 所以，为你们的缘故， 锡安必像被耕种的田地， 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆， 这殿的山要成为丛林中的高冈。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，为你们的缘故， 锡安必像被耕种的田地， 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆， 这殿的山要成为丛林中的高冈。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以因你们的缘故， 锡安必被耕种像一块田， 耶路撒冷必变为乱堆； 这殿的山必像丛林的高处。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a field; Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded height.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed like a field, Jerusalem shall become heaps of ruins, And the mountain of the temple Like the bare hills of the forest.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of you, Mount Zion will be plowed like an open field; Jerusalem will be reduced to ruins! A thicket will grow on the heights where the Temple now stands.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore on account of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins, And the mountain of the temple will become high places of a forest.
verses.textEn: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.

verses.textZh: 到末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山， 必矗立在万山之上， 高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山， 必矗立在万山之上， 高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。
verses.textZhCuv: 末后的日子， 耶和华殿的山必坚立， 超乎诸山，高举过于万岭； 万民都要流归这山。
verses.textEnNiv: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.
verses.textEnEsv: It shall come to pass in the latter days that the mountain of the house of the Lord shall be established as the highest of the mountains, and it shall be lifted up above the hills; and peoples shall flow to it,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it shall come to pass in the latter days That the mountain of the Lord’s house Shall be established on the top of the mountains, And shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow to it.
verses.textEnNlt: In the last days, the mountain of the Lord ’s house will be the highest of all— the most important place on earth. It will be raised above the other hills, and people from all over the world will stream there to worship.
verses.textEnNasb: And it will come about in the last days That the mountain of the house of the Lord Will be established as the chief of the mountains. It will be raised above the hills, And the peoples will stream to it.
verses.textEn: In the last days the mountain of the Lord ’s temple will be established as the highest of the mountains; it will be exalted above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.

verses.textZh: 必有多国的人前来说： "来吧！我们上耶和华的山， 登雅各神的殿； 他必把他的道路指示我们， 我们也要遵行他的道； 因为教训必出于锡安。 耶和华的话要来自耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有多国的人前来说： "来吧！我们上耶和华的山， 登雅各神的殿； 他必把他的道路指示我们， 我们也要遵行他的道； 因为教训必出于锡安。 耶和华的话要来自耶路撒冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有许多国的民前往，说： 来吧，我们登耶和华的山， 奔雅各神的殿。 主必将他的道教训我们； 我们也要行他的路。 因为训诲必出于锡安； 耶和华的言语必出于耶路撒冷。
verses.textEnNiv: Many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: and many nations shall come, and say: "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the house of the God of Jacob, that he may teach us his ways and that we may walk in his paths." For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many nations shall come and say, "Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, To the house of the God of Jacob; He will teach us His ways, And we shall walk in His paths." For out of Zion the law shall go forth, And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: People from many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the house of Jacob’s God. There he will teach us his ways, and we will walk in his paths." For the Lord ’s teaching will go out from Zion; his word will go out from Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: Many nations will come and say, "Come and let’s go up to the mountain of the Lord And to the house of the God of Jacob, So that He may teach us about His ways, And that we may walk in His paths." For from Zion will go forth the law, And the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Many nations will come and say, "Come, let us go up to the mountain of the Lord , to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us his ways, so that we may walk in his paths." The law will go out from Zion, the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: "他要在多族中施行审判， 为远方的强国断定是非。 他们必把刀剑打成犁头， 把矛枪打成镰刀； 这国不举刀攻击那国， 他们也不再学习战事。
verses.textZhCnvs: "他要在多族中施行审判， 为远方的强国断定是非。 他们必把刀剑打成犁头， 把矛枪打成镰刀； 这国不举刀攻击那国， 他们也不再学习战事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必在多国的民中施行审判， 为远方强盛的国断定是非。 他们要将刀打成犁头， 把枪打成镰刀。 这国不举刀攻击那国； 他们也不再学习战事。
verses.textEnNiv: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall judge between many peoples, and shall decide disputes for strong nations far away; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war anymore;
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall judge between many peoples, And rebuke strong nations afar off; They shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will mediate between peoples and will settle disputes between strong nations far away. They will hammer their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will no longer fight against nation, nor train for war anymore.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will judge between many peoples And render decisions for mighty, distant nations. Then they will beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruning hooks; Nation will not lift a sword against nation, And never again will they train for war.
verses.textEn: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

verses.textZh: 各人都要坐在自己的葡萄树， 和无花果树下， 无人惊吓他们， 因为万军之耶和华亲口说过了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各人都要坐在自己的葡萄树， 和无花果树下， 无人惊吓他们， 因为万军之耶和华亲口说过了。
verses.textZhCuv: 人人都要坐在自己葡萄树下 和无花果树下，无人惊吓。 这是万军之耶和华亲口说的。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone will sit under their own vine and under their own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the Lord Almighty has spoken.
verses.textEnEsv: but they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree, and no one shall make them afraid, for the mouth of the Lord of hosts has spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: But everyone shall sit under his vine and under his fig tree, And no one shall make them afraid; For the mouth of the Lord of hosts has spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone will live in peace and prosperity, enjoying their own grapevines and fig trees, for there will be nothing to fear. The Lord of Heaven’s Armies has made this promise!
verses.textEnNasb: Instead, each of them will sit under his vine And under his fig tree, With no one to make them afraid, Because the mouth of the Lord of armies has spoken.
verses.textEn: Everyone will sit under their own vine and under their own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid, for the Lord Almighty has spoken.

verses.textZh: 虽然，万民各奉自己神的名行事， 我们却要永远奉耶和华我们神的名而行。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然，万民各奉自己神的名行事， 我们却要永远奉耶和华我们神的名而行。"
verses.textZhCuv: 万民各奉己神的名而行； 我们却永永远远奉耶和华－我们神的名而行。
verses.textEnNiv: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: For all the peoples walk each in the name of its god, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: For all people walk each in the name of his god, But we will walk in the name of the Lord our God Forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Though the nations around us follow their idols, we will follow the Lord our God forever and ever.
verses.textEnNasb: Though all the peoples walk, Each in the name of his god, As for us, we will walk In the name of the Lord our God forever and ever.
verses.textEn: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods, but we will walk in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："到那日， 我必召聚瘸腿的， 集合被赶散的， 和我所苦待的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："到那日， 我必召聚瘸腿的， 集合被赶散的， 和我所苦待的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：到那日， 我必聚集瘸腿的， 招聚被赶出的和我所惩治的。
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord , "I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day, declares the Lord , I will assemble the lame and gather those who have been driven away and those whom I have afflicted;
verses.textEnNkjv: "In that day," says the Lord, "I will assemble the lame, I will gather the outcast And those whom I have afflicted;
verses.textEnNlt: "In that coming day," says the Lord , "I will gather together those who are lame, those who have been exiles, and those whom I have filled with grief.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day," declares the Lord, "I will assemble those who limp And gather the scattered, Those whom I have afflicted.
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord , "I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.

verses.textZh: 我必使瘸腿的作余民； 使被放逐的成为强国； 耶和华必在锡安山作王统治他们， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使瘸腿的作余民； 使被放逐的成为强国； 耶和华必在锡安山作王统治他们， 从现在直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使瘸腿的为余剩之民， 使赶到远方的为强盛之民。 耶和华要在锡安山作王治理他们， 从今直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the lame my remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The Lord will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.
verses.textEnEsv: and the lame I will make the remnant, and those who were cast off, a strong nation; and the Lord will reign over them in Mount Zion from this time forth and forevermore.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make the lame a remnant, And the outcast a strong nation; So the Lord will reign over them in Mount Zion From now on, even forever.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are weak will survive as a remnant; those who were exiles will become a strong nation. Then I, the Lord , will rule from Jerusalem as their king forever."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make those who limp a remnant, And those who have strayed a mighty nation, And the Lord will reign over them on Mount Zion From now on and forever.
verses.textEn: I will make the lame my remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The Lord will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

verses.textZh: 你这羊群的守望楼啊！ 锡安女子的俄斐勒啊！ 从前的权柄，必归给你， 就是耶路撒冷女子的国权， 要归还给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这羊群的守望楼啊！ 锡安女子的俄斐勒啊！ 从前的权柄，必归给你， 就是耶路撒冷女子的国权， 要归还给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这羊群的高台、锡安城 的山哪， 从前的权柄－ 就是耶路撒冷民 的国权－ 必归与你。
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of Daughter Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to Daughter Jerusalem."
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O tower of the flock, hill of the daughter of Zion, to you shall it come, the former dominion shall come, kingship for the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you, O tower of the flock, The stronghold of the daughter of Zion, To you shall it come, Even the former dominion shall come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem."
verses.textEnNlt: As for you, Jerusalem, the citadel of God’s people, your royal might and power will come back to you again. The kingship will be restored to my precious Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, tower of the flock, Hill of the daughter of Zion, To you it will come— Yes, the former dominion will come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: As for you, watchtower of the flock, stronghold of Daughter Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to Daughter Jerusalem."

verses.textZh: 现在你为甚么大声呼喊？ 难道你们中间没有君王吗？ 或是你的谋士灭亡了， 以致疼痛抓紧你，好象临产的妇人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你为甚么大声呼喊？ 难道你们中间没有君王吗？ 或是你的谋士灭亡了， 以致疼痛抓紧你，好象临产的妇人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你为何大声哭号呢？ 疼痛抓住你仿佛产难的妇人， 是因你中间没有君王吗？ 你的谋士灭亡了吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Why do you now cry aloud— have you no king ? Has your ruler perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?
verses.textEnEsv: Now why do you cry aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pain seized you like a woman in labor?
verses.textEnNkjv: Now why do you cry aloud? Isthere no king in your midst? Has your counselor perished? For pangs have seized you like a woman in labor.
verses.textEnNlt: But why are you now screaming in terror? Have you no king to lead you? Have your wise people all died? Pain has gripped you like a woman in childbirth.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now, why do you cry out loudly? Is there no king among you, Or has your counselor perished, That agony has gripped you like a woman in childbirth?
verses.textEn: Why do you now cry aloud— have you no king ? Has your ruler perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?

verses.textZh: 锡安的女子啊！ 你要疼痛劬劳， 好象临产的妇人； 因为现在你要从城里出来， 住在田野， 一定要到巴比伦去； 在那里你要蒙拯救， 在那里耶和华必救赎你， 脱离仇敌的掌握。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的女子啊！ 你要疼痛劬劳， 好象临产的妇人； 因为现在你要从城里出来， 住在田野， 一定要到巴比伦去； 在那里你要蒙拯救， 在那里耶和华必救赎你， 脱离仇敌的掌握。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民 哪， 你要疼痛劬劳，仿佛产难的妇人； 因为你必从城里出来， 住在田野，到巴比伦去。 在那里要蒙解救； 在那里耶和华必救赎你脱离仇敌的手。
verses.textEnNiv: Writhe in agony, Daughter Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the Lord will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.
verses.textEnEsv: Writhe and groan, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you shall go out from the city and dwell in the open country; you shall go to Babylon. There you shall be rescued; there the Lord will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, Like a woman in birth pangs. For now you shall go forth from the city, You shall dwell in the field, And to Babylon you shall go. There you shall be delivered; There the Lord will redeem you From the hand of your enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: Writhe and groan like a woman in labor, you people of Jerusalem, for now you must leave this city to live in the open country. You will soon be sent in exile to distant Babylon. But the Lord will rescue you there; he will redeem you from the grip of your enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Writhe and scream, Daughter of Zion, Like a woman in childbirth; For now you will go out of the city, Live in the field, And go to Babylon. There you will be rescued, There the Lord will redeem you From the hand of your enemies.
verses.textEn: Writhe in agony, Daughter Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the Lord will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.

verses.textZh: 现在多国的民集合起来， 攻击你，说：‘愿锡安被蹂躏， 愿我们亲眼看见锡安遭报应。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在多国的民集合起来， 攻击你，说：‘愿锡安被蹂躏， 愿我们亲眼看见锡安遭报应。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在有许多国的民聚集攻击你，说： 愿锡安被玷污！ 愿我们亲眼见她遭报！
verses.textEnNiv: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, "Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!"
verses.textEnEsv: Now many nations are assembled against you, saying, "Let her be defiled, and let our eyes gaze upon Zion."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now also many nations have gathered against you, Who say, "Let her be defiled, And let our eye look upon Zion."
verses.textEnNlt: Now many nations have gathered against you. "Let her be desecrated," they say. "Let us see the destruction of Jerusalem. "
verses.textEnNasb: "And now many nations have been assembled against you Who say, ‘Let her be defiled, And let our eyes gloat over Zion!’
verses.textEn: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, "Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!"

verses.textZh: 但是，他们却不知道耶和华的意念， 也不明白他的谋略； 他收集他们，好象把禾捆收集到禾场一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，他们却不知道耶和华的意念， 也不明白他的谋略； 他收集他们，好象把禾捆收集到禾场一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们却不知道耶和华的意念， 也不明白他的筹划。 他聚集他们，好像把禾捆聚到禾场一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord ; they do not understand his plan, that he has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.textEnEsv: But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord ; they do not understand his plan, that he has gathered them as sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord, Nor do they understand His counsel; For He will gather them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.textEnNlt: But they do not know the Lord ’s thoughts or understand his plan. These nations don’t know that he is gathering them together to be beaten and trampled like sheaves of grain on a threshing floor.
verses.textEnNasb: "But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord, And they do not understand His plan; For He has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.
verses.textEn: But they do not know the thoughts of the Lord ; they do not understand his plan, that he has gathered them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

verses.textZh: 锡安的女子啊！起来踹谷吧！ 因为我必使你的角成为铁， 使你的蹄成为铜； 你必粉碎许多民族， 毁灭他们所得的不义之财，作为祭物献与耶和华， 把他们的财宝献给全地的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的女子啊！起来踹谷吧！ 因为我必使你的角成为铁， 使你的蹄成为铜； 你必粉碎许多民族， 毁灭他们所得的不义之财，作为祭物献与耶和华， 把他们的财宝献给全地的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民 哪，起来踹谷吧！ 我必使你的角成为铁， 使你的蹄成为铜。 你必打碎多国的民， 将他们的财献与耶和华， 将他们的货献与普天下的主。
verses.textEnNiv: "Rise and thresh, Daughter Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hooves of bronze, and you will break to pieces many nations." You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the Lord , their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze; you shall beat in pieces many peoples; and shall devote their gain to the Lord , their wealth to the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; For I will make your horn iron, And I will make your hooves bronze; You shall beat in pieces many peoples; I will consecrate their gain to the Lord, And their substance to the Lord of the whole earth."
verses.textEnNlt: "Rise up and crush the nations, O Jerusalem!" says the Lord . "For I will give you iron horns and bronze hooves, so you can trample many nations to pieces. You will present their stolen riches to the Lord , their wealth to the Lord of all the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, For I will make your horn iron, And I will make your hoofs bronze, So that you may pulverize many peoples, And dedicate to the Lord their unjust profit, And their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
verses.textEn: "Rise and thresh, Daughter Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hooves of bronze, and you will break to pieces many nations." You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the Lord , their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

verses.textZh: 女子啊！现在你要聚集成队； 仇敌正在围攻我们； 他们用杖击打以色列执政者的脸颊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 女子啊！现在你要聚集成队； 仇敌正在围攻我们； 他们用杖击打以色列执政者的脸颊。
verses.textZhCuv: 成群的民 哪，现在你要聚集成队； 因为仇敌围攻我们， 要用杖击打以色列审判者的脸。
verses.textEnNiv: Marshal your troops now, city of troops, for a siege is laid against us. They will strike Israel’s ruler on the cheek with a rod.
verses.textEnEsv: Now muster your troops, O daughter of troops; siege is laid against us; with a rod they strike the judge of Israel on the cheek.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now gather yourself in troops, O daughter of troops; He has laid siege against us; They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.
verses.textEnNlt: Mobilize! Marshal your troops! The enemy is laying siege to Jerusalem. They will strike Israel’s leader in the face with a rod.
verses.textEnNasb: " Now muster yourselves in troops, daughter of troops; They have laid siege against us; With a rod they will strike the judge of Israel on the cheek.
verses.textEn: Marshal your troops now, city of troops, for a siege is laid against us. They will strike Israel’s ruler on the cheek with a rod.

verses.textZh: 伯利恒以法他啊！ 你在犹大诸城中虽然细小 ， 必有一位从你那里出来，为我作以色列的统治者； 他的根源从太初， 从亘古就有了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯利恒以法他啊！ 你在犹大诸城中虽然细小 ， 必有一位从你那里出来，为我作以色列的统治者； 他的根源从太初， 从亘古就有了。
verses.textZhCuv: 伯利恒的以法他啊， 你在犹大诸城中为小， 将来必有一位从你那里出来， 在以色列中为我作掌权的； 他的根源从亘古，从太初就有。
verses.textEnNiv: "But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times."
verses.textEnEsv: But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are too little to be among the clans of Judah, from you shall come forth for me one who is to be ruler in Israel, whose coming forth is from of old, from ancient days.
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, Though you are little among the thousands of Judah, Yet out of you shall come forth to Me The One to be Ruler in Israel, Whose goings forth are from of old, From everlasting."
verses.textEnNlt: But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah, are only a small village among all the people of Judah. Yet a ruler of Israel, whose origins are in the distant past, will come from you on my behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: " But as for you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, Too little to be among the clans of Judah, From you One will come forth for Me to be ruler in Israel. His times of coming forth are from long ago, From the days of eternity."
verses.textEn: "But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times."

verses.textZh: 因此，耶和华必把以色列人交给敌人， 直到那要生产的妇人生下孩子来； 那时，他其余的兄弟， 就必归回以色列人那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，耶和华必把以色列人交给敌人， 直到那要生产的妇人生下孩子来； 那时，他其余的兄弟， 就必归回以色列人那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必将以色列人交付敌人， 直等那生产的妇人生下子来。 那时掌权者 其余的弟兄 必归到以色列人那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor bears a son, and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore he shall give them up until the time when she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of his brothers shall return to the people of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He shall give them up, Until the time that she who is in labor has given birth; Then the remnant of His brethren Shall return to the children of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will be abandoned to their enemies until the woman in labor gives birth. Then at last his fellow countrymen will return from exile to their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore He will give them up until the time When she who is in labor has given birth. Then the remainder of His kinsmen Will return to the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor bears a son, and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.

verses.textZh: 他必站立起来， 靠着耶和华的能力， 靠着耶和华他神之名的威严， 牧养他的羊群； 他们必然安居， 因为那时他必尊大， 直到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必站立起来， 靠着耶和华的能力， 靠着耶和华他神之名的威严， 牧养他的羊群； 他们必然安居， 因为那时他必尊大， 直到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必起来，倚靠耶和华的大能， 并耶和华－他神之名的威严， 牧养他的羊群。 他们要安然居住； 因为他必日见尊大，直到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the Lord , in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the Lord , in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God. And they shall dwell secure, for now he shall be great to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He shall stand and feed Hisflock In the strength of the Lord, In the majesty of the name of the Lord His God; And they shall abide, For now He shall be great To the ends of the earth;
verses.textEnNlt: And he will stand to lead his flock with the Lord ’s strength, in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God. Then his people will live there undisturbed, for he will be highly honored around the world.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will arise and shepherd His flock In the strength of the Lord, In the majesty of the name of the Lord His God. And they will remain, Because at that time He will be great To the ends of the earth.
verses.textEn: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the Lord , in the majesty of the name of the Lord his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 这就是那带来太平的。 亚述人入侵我们的国土， 践踏我们宫殿的时候， 我们就要兴起七个牧者； 八个作领袖的人攻击他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是那带来太平的。 亚述人入侵我们的国土， 践踏我们宫殿的时候， 我们就要兴起七个牧者； 八个作领袖的人攻击他。
verses.textZhCuv: 这位必作我们的平安。 当亚述人进入我们的地境， 践踏宫殿的时候， 我们就立起七个牧者， 八个首领攻击他。
verses.textEnNiv: And he will be our peace when the Assyrians invade our land and march through our fortresses. We will raise against them seven shepherds, even eight commanders,
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall be their peace. When the Assyrian comes into our land and treads in our palaces, then we will raise against him seven shepherds and eight princes of men;
verses.textEnNkjv: And this One shall be peace. When the Assyrian comes into our land, And when he treads in our palaces, Then we will raise against him Seven shepherds and eight princely men.
verses.textEnNlt: And he will be the source of peace. When the Assyrians invade our land and break through our defenses, we will appoint seven rulers to watch over us, eight princes to lead us.
verses.textEnNasb: This One will be our peace. When the Assyrian invades our land, When he tramples on our citadels, Then we will raise against him Seven shepherds and eight leaders of people.
verses.textEn: And he will be our peace when the Assyrians invade our land and march through our fortresses. We will raise against them seven shepherds, even eight commanders,

verses.textZh: 他们必用刀剑治理亚述地， 必用剑锋治理宁录地； 亚述人入侵我们的国土， 践踏我们境界的时候， 他必拯救我们脱离亚述人的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们必用刀剑治理亚述地， 必用剑锋治理宁录地； 亚述人入侵我们的国土， 践踏我们境界的时候， 他必拯救我们脱离亚述人的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必用刀剑毁坏亚述地 和宁录地的关口。 亚述人进入我们的地境践踏的时候， 他必拯救我们。
verses.textEnNiv: who will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrians when they invade our land and march across our borders.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod at its entrances; and he shall deliver us from the Assyrian when he comes into our land and treads within our border.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall waste with the sword the land of Assyria, And the land of Nimrod at its entrances; Thus He shall deliver us from the Assyrian, When he comes into our land And when he treads within our borders.
verses.textEnNlt: They will rule Assyria with drawn swords and enter the gates of the land of Nimrod. He will rescue us from the Assyrians when they pour over the borders to invade our land.
verses.textEnNasb: They will shepherd the land of Assyria with the sword, The land of Nimrod at its entrances; And He will rescue us from the Assyrian When he invades our land, And when he tramples our territory.
verses.textEn: who will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrians when they invade our land and march across our borders.

verses.textZh: 那时，雅各的余民， 必在许多民族中， 像从耶和华那里降下的露水， 又像甘霖降在草上， 不期望于人， 也不等候世人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，雅各的余民， 必在许多民族中， 像从耶和华那里降下的露水， 又像甘霖降在草上， 不期望于人， 也不等候世人。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各余剩的人必在多国的民中， 如从耶和华那里降下的露水， 又如甘霖降在草上； 不仗赖人力，也不等候世人之功。
verses.textEnNiv: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the Lord , like showers on the grass, which do not wait for anyone or depend on man.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the Lord , like showers on the grass, which delay not for a man nor wait for the children of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the remnant of Jacob Shall be in the midst of many peoples, Like dew from the Lord, Like showers on the grass, That tarry for no man Nor wait for the sons of men.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the remnant left in Israel will take their place among the nations. They will be like dew sent by the Lord or like rain falling on the grass, which no one can hold back and no one can restrain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the remnant of Jacob Will be among many peoples Like dew from the Lord, Like showers on vegetation That do not wait for man, Or delay for mankind.
verses.textEn: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the Lord , like showers on the grass, which do not wait for anyone or depend on man.

verses.textZh: 那时雅各的余民， 必在万国中， 在许多民族里， 像树林里百兽中的狮子， 又像幼狮在羊群中； 他若经过， 就必践踏、撕碎， 没有人可以拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时雅各的余民， 必在万国中， 在许多民族里， 像树林里百兽中的狮子， 又像幼狮在羊群中； 他若经过， 就必践踏、撕碎， 没有人可以拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各余剩的人必在多国多民中， 如林间百兽中的狮子， 又如少壮狮子在羊群中。 他若经过就必践踏撕裂， 无人搭救。
verses.textEnNiv: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.
verses.textEnEsv: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep, which, when it goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is none to deliver.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the remnant of Jacob Shall be among the Gentiles, In the midst of many peoples, Like a lion among the beasts of the forest, Like a young lion among flocks of sheep, Who, if he passes through, Both treads down and tears in pieces, And none can deliver.
verses.textEnNlt: The remnant left in Israel will take their place among the nations. They will be like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a strong young lion among flocks of sheep and goats, pouncing and tearing as they go with no rescuer in sight.
verses.textEnNasb: The remnant of Jacob Will be among the nations, Among many peoples Like a lion among the animals of the forest, Like a young lion among flocks of sheep, Which, if he passes through, Tramples and tears, And there is no one who can rescue.
verses.textEn: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.

verses.textZh: 愿你的手举起高过你的敌人， 愿你的一切仇敌都被剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你的手举起高过你的敌人， 愿你的一切仇敌都被剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你的手举起，高过敌人！ 愿你的仇敌都被剪除！
verses.textEnNiv: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Your hand shall be lifted up over your adversaries, and all your enemies shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your hand shall be lifted against your adversaries, And all your enemies shall be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Israel will stand up to their foes, and all their enemies will be wiped out.
verses.textEnNasb: Your hand will be lifted up against your adversaries, And all your enemies will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："到那日， 我必从你中间剪除你的马匹， 毁灭你的车辆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："到那日， 我必从你中间剪除你的马匹， 毁灭你的车辆，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：到那日， 我必从你中间剪除马匹， 毁坏车辆，
verses.textEnNiv: "In that day," declares the Lord , "I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.
verses.textEnEsv: And in that day, declares the Lord , I will cut off your horses from among you and will destroy your chariots;
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be in that day," says the Lord, "That I will cut off your horses from your midst And destroy your chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: "In that day," says the Lord , "I will slaughter your horses and destroy your chariots.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will be on that day," declares the Lord, "That I will eliminate your horses from among you, And destroy your chariots.
verses.textEn: "In that day," declares the Lord , "I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.

verses.textZh: 拆毁你国中的城市， 倾覆你的一切保障；
verses.textZhCnvs: 拆毁你国中的城市， 倾覆你的一切保障；
verses.textZhCuv: 也必从你国中除灭城邑， 拆毁一切的保障，
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will cut off the cities of your land and throw down all your strongholds;
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cut off the cities of your land And throw down all your strongholds.
verses.textEnNlt: I will tear down your walls and demolish your defenses.
