verses.textEnNasb: "I will also eliminate the cities of your land, And tear down all your fortifications.
verses.textEn: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

verses.textZh: 我必从你的手中除掉巫术， 你那里就不再有占卜的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从你的手中除掉巫术， 你那里就不再有占卜的；
verses.textZhCuv: 又必除掉你手中的邪术； 你那里也不再有占卜的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will cut off sorceries from your hand, and you shall have no more tellers of fortunes;
verses.textEnNkjv: I will cut off sorceries from your hand, And you shall have no soothsayers.
verses.textEnNlt: I will put an end to all witchcraft, and there will be no more fortune-tellers.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will eliminate sorceries from your hand, And you will have no fortune-tellers.
verses.textEn: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.

verses.textZh: 我必从你中间 除掉你雕刻的偶像和柱像， 你就不再跪拜 你手所做的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从你中间 除掉你雕刻的偶像和柱像， 你就不再跪拜 你手所做的；
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从你中间除灭雕刻的偶像和柱像， 你就不再跪拜自己手所造的。
verses.textEnNiv: I will destroy your idols and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will cut off your carved images and your pillars from among you, and you shall bow down no more to the work of your hands;
verses.textEnNkjv: Your carved images I will also cut off, And your sacred pillars from your midst; You shall no more worship the work of your hands;
verses.textEnNlt: I will destroy all your idols and sacred pillars, so you will never again worship the work of your own hands.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will eliminate your carved images And your memorial stones from among you, So that you will no longer bow down To the work of your hands.
verses.textEn: I will destroy your idols and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.

verses.textZh: 我必从你中间除灭你的亚舍拉， 毁灭你的偶像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必从你中间除灭你的亚舍拉， 毁灭你的偶像。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必从你中间拔出木偶， 又毁灭你的城邑。
verses.textEnNiv: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles when I demolish your cities.
verses.textEnEsv: and I will root out your Asherah images from among you and destroy your cities.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will pluck your wooden images from your midst; Thus I will destroy your cities.
verses.textEnNlt: I will abolish your idol shrines with their Asherah poles and destroy your pagan cities.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will uproot your Asherim from among you, And destroy your cities.
verses.textEn: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles when I demolish your cities.

verses.textZh: 我必在忿怒和烈怒中， 向那些不听从的列国施行报复。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必在忿怒和烈怒中， 向那些不听从的列国施行报复。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也必在怒气和忿怒中向那不听从的列国施报。
verses.textEnNiv: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that have not obeyed me."
verses.textEnEsv: And in anger and wrath I will execute vengeance on the nations that did not obey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury On the nations that have not heard."
verses.textEnNlt: I will pour out my vengeance on all the nations that refuse to obey me."
verses.textEnNasb: "And I will execute vengeance in anger and wrath On the nations which have not obeyed."
verses.textEn: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath on the nations that have not obeyed me."

verses.textZh: 你们当听耶和华所说的话： "你要起来，向大山争辩， 让小山可以听见你的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们当听耶和华所说的话： "你要起来，向大山争辩， 让小山可以听见你的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人哪，当听耶和华的话！ 要起来向山岭争辩， 使冈陵听你的话。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen to what the Lord says: "Stand up, plead my case before the mountains; let the hills hear what you have to say.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear what the Lord says: Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear now what the Lord says: "Arise, plead your case before the mountains, And let the hills hear your voice.
verses.textEnNlt: Listen to what the Lord is saying: "Stand up and state your case against me. Let the mountains and hills be called to witness your complaints.
verses.textEnNasb: Hear now what the Lord is saying, "Arise, plead your case before the mountains, And let the hills hear your voice.
verses.textEn: Listen to what the Lord says: "Stand up, plead my case before the mountains; let the hills hear what you have to say.

verses.textZh: 大山啊！你们要听耶和华的争辩。 大地永久的根基啊！你们要听， 因为耶和华与他的子民争辩， 和以色列争论。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大山啊！你们要听耶和华的争辩。 大地永久的根基啊！你们要听， 因为耶和华与他的子民争辩， 和以色列争论。
verses.textZhCuv: 山岭和地永久的根基啊， 要听耶和华争辩的话！ 因为耶和华要与他的百姓争辩， 与以色列争论。
verses.textEnNiv: "Hear, you mountains, the Lord ’s accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the Lord has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Hear, you mountains, the indictment of the Lord , and you enduring foundations of the earth, for the Lord has an indictment against his people, and he will contend with Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hear, O you mountains, the Lord’s complaint, And you strong foundations of the earth; For the Lord has a complaint against His people, And He will contend with Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And now, O mountains, listen to the Lord ’s complaint! He has a case against his people. He will bring charges against Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen, you mountains, to the indictment by the Lord, And you enduring foundations of the earth, Because the Lord has a case against His people; And He will dispute with Israel.
verses.textEn: "Hear, you mountains, the Lord ’s accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the Lord has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.

verses.textZh: 我的子民啊，我向你作了甚么呢？ 我在甚么事上叫你厌烦呢？ 你可以回答我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的子民啊，我向你作了甚么呢？ 我在甚么事上叫你厌烦呢？ 你可以回答我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓啊，我向你做了什么呢？ 我在什么事上使你厌烦？ 你可以对我证明。
verses.textEnNiv: "My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.
verses.textEnEsv: "O my people, what have I done to you? How have I wearied you? Answer me!
verses.textEnNkjv: "O My people, what have I done to you? And how have I wearied you? Testify against Me.
verses.textEnNlt: "O my people, what have I done to you? What have I done to make you tired of me? Answer me!
verses.textEnNasb: "My people, what have I done to you, And how have I wearied you? Answer Me.
verses.textEn: "My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.

verses.textZh: 我曾经把你从埃及地领上来， 把你从为奴之家赎出来； 我也差派了摩西、亚伦和米利暗在你前面行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我曾经把你从埃及地领上来， 把你从为奴之家赎出来； 我也差派了摩西、亚伦和米利暗在你前面行。
verses.textZhCuv: 我曾将你从埃及地领出来， 从作奴仆之家救赎你； 我也差遣摩西、亚伦，和米利暗在你前面行。
verses.textEnNiv: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.
verses.textEnEsv: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery, and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, I redeemed you from the house of bondage; And I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.textEnNlt: For I brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from slavery. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to help you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Indeed, I brought you up from the land of Egypt, I redeemed you from the house of slavery, And I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.textEn: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.

verses.textZh: 我的民哪！你们要追念， 摩押王巴勒图谋过甚么， 比珥的儿子巴兰又答应了他甚么， 以及你们从什亭到吉甲所发生的事， 好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的民哪！你们要追念， 摩押王巴勒图谋过甚么， 比珥的儿子巴兰又答应了他甚么， 以及你们从什亭到吉甲所发生的事， 好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的百姓啊，你们当追念摩押王巴勒所设的谋 和比珥的儿子巴兰回答他的话， 并你们从什亭到吉甲所遇见的事， 好使你们知道耶和华公义的作为。
verses.textEnNiv: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: O my people, remember what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, and what happened from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: O My people, remember now What Balak king of Moab counseled, And what Balaam the son of Beor answered him, From Acacia Grove to Gilgal, That you may know the righteousness of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you remember, my people, how King Balak of Moab tried to have you cursed and how Balaam son of Beor blessed you instead? And remember your journey from Acacia Grove to Gilgal, when I, the Lord , did everything I could to teach you about my faithfulness."
verses.textEnNasb: "My people, remember now What Balak king of Moab planned And what Balaam son of Beor answered him, And what happened from Shittim to Gilgal, So that you might know the righteous acts of the Lord."
verses.textEn: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab plotted and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember your journey from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 我朝见耶和华， 在至高的神面前叩拜，当献上甚么呢？ 我朝见他的时候，当献上燔祭， 当献上一岁的牛犊吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我朝见耶和华， 在至高的神面前叩拜，当献上甚么呢？ 我朝见他的时候，当献上燔祭， 当献上一岁的牛犊吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我朝见耶和华， 在至高神面前跪拜，当献上什么呢？ 岂可献一岁的牛犊为燔祭吗？
verses.textEnNiv: With what shall I come before the Lord and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.textEnEsv: "With what shall I come before the Lord , and bow myself before God on high? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
verses.textEnNkjv: With what shall I come before the Lord, And bow myself before the High God? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, With calves a year old?
verses.textEnNlt: What can we bring to the Lord ? Should we bring him burnt offerings? Should we bow before God Most High with offerings of yearling calves?
verses.textEnNasb: With what shall I come to the Lord And bow myself before the God on high? Shall I come to Him with burnt offerings, With yearling calves?
verses.textEn: With what shall I come before the Lord and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

verses.textZh: 耶和华喜悦千千的公羊， 或是万万的油河吗？ 为我的过犯，我可以献上我的长子吗？ 为我的罪恶，献上我亲生的孩子吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华喜悦千千的公羊， 或是万万的油河吗？ 为我的过犯，我可以献上我的长子吗？ 为我的罪恶，献上我亲生的孩子吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华岂喜悦千千的公羊， 或是万万的油河吗？ 我岂可为自己的罪过献我的长子吗？ 为心中的罪恶献我身所生的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.textEnEsv: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, Ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.textEnNlt: Should we offer him thousands of rams and ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Should we sacrifice our firstborn children to pay for our sins?
verses.textEnNasb: Does the Lord take pleasure in thousands of rams, In ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I give Him my firstborn for my wrongdoings, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
verses.textEn: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of olive oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

verses.textZh: 世人哪！耶和华已经指示你甚么是善， 他向你所要的又是甚么； 无非是要你行公义，好怜悯， 谦虚谨慎与你的神同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 世人哪！耶和华已经指示你甚么是善， 他向你所要的又是甚么； 无非是要你行公义，好怜悯， 谦虚谨慎与你的神同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 世人哪，耶和华已指示你何为善。 他向你所要的是什么呢？ 只要你行公义，好怜悯， 存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。
verses.textEnNiv: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verses.textEnEsv: He has told you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
verses.textEnNkjv: He has shown you, O man, what is good; And what does the Lord require of you But to do justly, To love mercy, And to walk humbly with your God?
verses.textEnNlt: No, O people, the Lord has told you what is good, and this is what he requires of you: to do what is right, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
verses.textEnNasb: He has told you, mortal one, what is good; And what does the Lord require of you But to do justice, to love kindness, And to walk humbly with your God?
verses.textEn: He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

verses.textZh: 听啊！耶和华向这城呼叫， 敬畏你的名就是智慧； 支派和城里的会众啊！你们要听。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！耶和华向这城呼叫， 敬畏你的名就是智慧； 支派和城里的会众啊！你们要听。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向这城呼叫， 智慧人必敬畏他的名。 你们当听是谁派定刑杖的惩罚。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! The Lord is calling to the city— and to fear your name is wisdom— "Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of the Lord cries to the city— and it is sound wisdom to fear your name: "Hear of the rod and of him who appointed it!
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord’s voice cries to the city— Wisdom shall see Your name: "Hear the rod! Who has appointed it?
verses.textEnNlt: Fear the Lord if you are wise! His voice calls to everyone in Jerusalem: "The armies of destruction are coming; the Lord is sending them.
verses.textEnNasb: The voice of the Lord will call to the city— And it is sound wisdom to fear Your name: " Hear, you tribe. Who has designated its time?
verses.textEn: Listen! The Lord is calling to the city— and to fear your name is wisdom— "Heed the rod and the One who appointed it.

verses.textZh: 我怎能忘记恶人家中的不义之财， 和那些可咒诅的小升斗呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我怎能忘记恶人家中的不义之财， 和那些可咒诅的小升斗呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 恶人家中不仍有非义之财 和可恶的小升斗吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Am I still to forget your ill-gotten treasures, you wicked house, and the short ephah, which is accursed?
verses.textEnEsv: Can I forget any longer the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is accursed?
verses.textEnNkjv: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness In the house of the wicked, And the short measure thatis an abomination?
verses.textEnNlt: What shall I say about the homes of the wicked filled with treasures gained by cheating? What about the disgusting practice of measuring out grain with dishonest measures?
verses.textEnNasb: "Is there still a person in the wicked house, Along with treasures of wickedness, And a short measure that is cursed?
verses.textEn: Am I still to forget your ill-gotten treasures, you wicked house, and the short ephah, which is accursed?

verses.textZh: 用不义的天平， 和袋中诈骗的法码的人， 我怎能算他为清洁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 用不义的天平， 和袋中诈骗的法码的人， 我怎能算他为清洁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中诡诈的法码， 岂可算为清洁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Shall I acquit someone with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?
verses.textEnEsv: Shall I acquit the man with wicked scales and with a bag of deceitful weights?
verses.textEnNkjv: Shall I count pure those with the wicked scales, And with the bag of deceitful weights?
verses.textEnNlt: How can I tolerate your merchants who use dishonest scales and weights?
verses.textEnNasb: "Can I justify dishonest balances, And a bag of fraudulent weights?
verses.textEn: Shall I acquit someone with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?

verses.textZh: 城里的财主充满了强暴， 其中的居民也说假话； 他们口中的舌头是诡诈的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城里的财主充满了强暴， 其中的居民也说假话； 他们口中的舌头是诡诈的。
verses.textZhCuv: 城里的富户满行强暴； 其中的居民也说谎言， 口中的舌头是诡诈的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your rich people are violent; your inhabitants are liars and their tongues speak deceitfully.
verses.textEnEsv: Your rich men are full of violence; your inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For her rich men are full of violence, Her inhabitants have spoken lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: The rich among you have become wealthy through extortion and violence. Your citizens are so used to lying that their tongues can no longer tell the truth.
verses.textEnNasb: "For the rich people of the city are full of violence, Her residents speak lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.textEn: Your rich people are violent; your inhabitants are liars and their tongues speak deceitfully.

verses.textZh: 因此我击打你，使你生病 ， 因你的罪恶，使你荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此我击打你，使你生病 ， 因你的罪恶，使你荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，我击打你， 使你的伤痕甚重， 使你因你的罪恶荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I strike you with a grievous blow, making you desolate because of your sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore I will also make you sick by striking you, By making you desolate because of your sins.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, I will wound you! I will bring you to ruin for all your sins.
verses.textEnNasb: "So also I will make you sick, striking you down, Making you desolate because of your sins.
verses.textEn: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.

verses.textZh: 你要吃，却吃不饱； 因你的腹中常有疾病。 你要怀孕，却不能生下来； 你生下来的， 我都要交给刀剑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要吃，却吃不饱； 因你的腹中常有疾病。 你要怀孕，却不能生下来； 你生下来的， 我都要交给刀剑。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要吃，却吃不饱； 你的虚弱必显在你中间。 你必挪去，却不得救护； 所救护的，我必交给刀剑。
verses.textEnNiv: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty. You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall eat, but not be satisfied, and there shall be hunger within you; you shall put away, but not preserve, and what you preserve I will give to the sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall eat, but not be satisfied; Hunger shallbe in your midst. You may carry some away, but shall not save them; And what you do rescue I will give over to the sword.
verses.textEnNlt: You will eat but never have enough. Your hunger pangs and emptiness will remain. And though you try to save your money, it will come to nothing in the end. You will save a little, but I will give it to those who conquer you.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will eat, but you will not be satisfied, And your filth will be in your midst. You will try to remove valuables for safekeeping, But you will not save it all, And what you do save I will turn over to the sword.
verses.textEn: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty. You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.

verses.textZh: 你要撒种，却不得收割， 你要榨橄榄油，却不得油抹身； 你要榨葡萄汁，却不得酒喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要撒种，却不得收割， 你要榨橄榄油，却不得油抹身； 你要榨葡萄汁，却不得酒喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必撒种，却不得收割； 踹橄榄，却不得油抹身； 踹葡萄，却不得酒喝。
verses.textEnNiv: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall sow, but not reap; you shall tread olives, but not anoint yourselves with oil; you shall tread grapes, but not drink wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You shall sow, but not reap; You shall tread the olives, but not anoint yourselves with oil; And make sweet wine, but not drink wine.
verses.textEnNlt: You will plant crops but not harvest them. You will press your olives but not get enough oil to anoint yourselves. You will trample the grapes but get no juice to make your wine.
verses.textEnNasb: "You will sow but you will not harvest. You will tread the olive press but will not anoint yourself with oil; And tread out sweet wine, but you will not drink any wine.
verses.textEn: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.

verses.textZh: 你跟随了暗利的规例 和亚哈家一切所行的， 顺从了他们的计谋； 因此，我必使你荒凉， 使你 的居民被嗤笑； 你们也必担当我民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你跟随了暗利的规例 和亚哈家一切所行的， 顺从了他们的计谋； 因此，我必使你荒凉， 使你 的居民被嗤笑； 你们也必担当我民的羞辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你守暗利的恶规， 行亚哈家一切所行的， 顺从他们的计谋； 因此，我必使你荒凉， 使你的居民令人嗤笑， 你们也必担当我民的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations. "
verses.textEnEsv: For you have kept the statutes of Omri, and all the works of the house of Ahab; and you have walked in their counsels, that I may make you a desolation, and your inhabitants a hissing; so you shall bear the scorn of my people."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the statutes of Omri are kept; All the works of Ahab’s house aredone; And you walk in their counsels, That I may make you a desolation, And your inhabitants a hissing. Therefore you shall bear the reproach of My people."
verses.textEnNlt: You keep only the laws of evil King Omri; you follow only the example of wicked King Ahab! Therefore, I will make an example of you, bringing you to complete ruin. You will be treated with contempt, mocked by all who see you."
verses.textEnNasb: "The statutes of Omri And every work of the house of Ahab are maintained, And you walk by their plans. Therefore I will give you up for destruction, And your inhabitants for derision, And you will suffer the taunting of My people."
verses.textEn: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab’s house; you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations. "

verses.textZh: 我有祸了！ 因为我好象夏天采摘的果子，又像摘剩的葡萄， 没有一挂可吃的， 也没有我心所想望早熟的无花果。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我有祸了！ 因为我好象夏天采摘的果子，又像摘剩的葡萄， 没有一挂可吃的， 也没有我心所想望早熟的无花果。
verses.textZhCuv: 哀哉！我 好像夏天的果子已被收尽， 又像摘了葡萄所剩下的， 没有一挂可吃的； 我心羡慕初熟的无花果。
verses.textEnNiv: What misery is mine! I am like one who gathers summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster of grapes to eat, none of the early figs that I crave.
verses.textEnEsv: Woe is me! For I have become as when the summer fruit has been gathered, as when the grapes have been gleaned: there is no cluster to eat, no first-ripe fig that my soul desires.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe is me! For I am like those who gather summer fruits, Like those who glean vintage grapes; Thereisno cluster to eat Of the first-ripe fruit which my soul desires.
verses.textEnNlt: How miserable I am! I feel like the fruit picker after the harvest who can find nothing to eat. Not a cluster of grapes or a single early fig can be found to satisfy my hunger.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to me! For I am Like harvests of summer fruit, like gleanings of grapes. There is not a cluster of grapes left to eat, Nor an early fig, which I crave.
verses.textEn: What misery is mine! I am like one who gathers summer fruit at the gleaning of the vineyard; there is no cluster of grapes to eat, none of the early figs that I crave.

verses.textZh: 虔敬的人从地上灭绝了， 人间也没有正直的人， 人人都埋伏着要流人的血， 各人都用网罗猎取自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虔敬的人从地上灭绝了， 人间也没有正直的人， 人人都埋伏着要流人的血， 各人都用网罗猎取自己的兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上虔诚人灭尽； 世间没有正直人； 各人埋伏，要杀人流血， 都用网罗猎取弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: The faithful have been swept from the land; not one upright person remains. Everyone lies in wait to shed blood; they hunt each other with nets.
verses.textEnEsv: The godly has perished from the earth, and there is no one upright among mankind; they all lie in wait for blood, and each hunts the other with a net.
verses.textEnNkjv: The faithful man has perished from the earth, And thereis no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; Every man hunts his brother with a net.
verses.textEnNlt: The godly people have all disappeared; not one honest person is left on the earth. They are all murderers, setting traps even for their own brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: The godly person has perished from the land, And there is no upright person among mankind. All of them lie in wait for bloodshed; Each of them hunts the other with a net.
verses.textEn: The faithful have been swept from the land; not one upright person remains. Everyone lies in wait to shed blood; they hunt each other with nets.

verses.textZh: 他们双手善于作恶， 官长和审判官都要求报酬； 达官贵人说出心里的欲望； 他们歪曲了一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们双手善于作恶， 官长和审判官都要求报酬； 达官贵人说出心里的欲望； 他们歪曲了一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们双手作恶； 君王徇情面，审判官要贿赂； 位分大的吐出恶意， 都彼此结联行恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire— they all conspire together.
verses.textEnEsv: Their hands are on what is evil, to do it well; the prince and the judge ask for a bribe, and the great man utters the evil desire of his soul; thus they weave it together.
verses.textEnNkjv: That they may successfully do evil with both hands— The prince asks forgifts, The judge seeks a bribe, And the great man utters his evil desire; So they scheme together.
verses.textEnNlt: Both their hands are equally skilled at doing evil! Officials and judges alike demand bribes. The people with influence get what they want, and together they scheme to twist justice.
verses.textEnNasb: As for evil, both hands do it well. The leader asks for a bribe, also the judge, And the great one speaks the capricious desire of his soul; So they plot it together.
verses.textEn: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire— they all conspire together.

verses.textZh: 他们中最好的，也不过像荆棘， 最正直的，也不过是有刺的篱笆。 你的守望者所预言的日子， 和你被鉴察的时候，已经来到； 现在他们必要慌乱不安。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中最好的，也不过像荆棘， 最正直的，也不过是有刺的篱笆。 你的守望者所预言的日子， 和你被鉴察的时候，已经来到； 现在他们必要慌乱不安。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们最好的，不过是蒺藜； 最正直的，不过是荆棘篱笆。 你守望者说，降罚的日子已经来到。 他们必扰乱不安。
verses.textEnNiv: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day God visits you has come, the day your watchmen sound the alarm. Now is the time of your confusion.
verses.textEnEsv: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright of them a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, of your punishment, has come; now their confusion is at hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: The best of them is like a brier; The most upright issharper than a thorn hedge; The day of your watchman and your punishment comes; Now shall be their perplexity.
verses.textEnNlt: Even the best of them is like a brier; the most honest is as dangerous as a hedge of thorns. But your judgment day is coming swiftly now. Your time of punishment is here, a time of confusion.
verses.textEnNasb: The best of them is like a thorn bush, The most upright like a thorn hedge. The day when you post your watchmen, Your punishment is coming. Then their confusion will occur.
verses.textEn: The best of them is like a brier, the most upright worse than a thorn hedge. The day God visits you has come, the day your watchmen sound the alarm. Now is the time of your confusion.

verses.textZh: 不可信靠邻舍， 也不可信任朋友， 要守住你的嘴唇， 不可向躺在你怀中的妻子透露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可信靠邻舍， 也不可信任朋友， 要守住你的嘴唇， 不可向躺在你怀中的妻子透露。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要倚赖邻舍； 不要信靠密友。 要守住你的口； 不要向你怀中的妻提说。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with the woman who lies in your embrace guard the words of your lips.
verses.textEnEsv: Put no trust in a neighbor; have no confidence in a friend; guard the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms;
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not trust in a friend; Do not put your confidence in a companion; Guard the doors of your mouth From her who lies in your bosom.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t trust anyone— not your best friend or even your wife!
verses.textEnNasb: Do not trust in a neighbor; Do not have confidence in a close friend. Guard your lips From her who lies in your arms.
verses.textEn: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with the woman who lies in your embrace guard the words of your lips.

verses.textZh: 儿子藐视父亲， 女儿抗拒母亲， 媳妇与婆婆作对； 人的仇敌就是自己的家人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 儿子藐视父亲， 女儿抗拒母亲， 媳妇与婆婆作对； 人的仇敌就是自己的家人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，儿子藐视父亲； 女儿抗拒母亲； 媳妇抗拒婆婆； 人的仇敌就是自己家里的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law— a man’s enemies are the members of his own household.
verses.textEnEsv: for the son treats the father with contempt, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.textEnNkjv: For son dishonors father, Daughter rises against her mother, Daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A man’s enemies are the men of his own household.
verses.textEnNlt: For the son despises his father. The daughter defies her mother. The daughter-in-law defies her mother-in-law. Your enemies are right in your own household!
verses.textEnNasb: For son disavows father, Daughter rises up against her mother, Daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A person’s enemies are the people of his own household.
verses.textEn: For a son dishonors his father, a daughter rises up against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law— a man’s enemies are the members of his own household.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我却要仰望耶和华， 我要等候那拯救我的神； 我的神必应允我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我却要仰望耶和华， 我要等候那拯救我的神； 我的神必应允我。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我要仰望耶和华， 要等候那救我的神； 我的神必应允我。
verses.textEnNiv: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord , I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, I will look to the Lord ; I will wait for the God of my salvation; my God will hear me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I will look to the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation; My God will hear me.
verses.textEnNlt: As for me, I look to the Lord for help. I wait confidently for God to save me, and my God will certainly hear me.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I will be on the watch for the Lord; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
verses.textEn: But as for me, I watch in hope for the Lord , I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌啊！不要因我的遭遇而高兴； 我虽然跌倒了，却必起来； 我虽然坐在黑暗里，耶和华却必作我的光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌啊！不要因我的遭遇而高兴； 我虽然跌倒了，却必起来； 我虽然坐在黑暗里，耶和华却必作我的光。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的仇敌啊，不要向我夸耀。 我虽跌倒，却要起来； 我虽坐在黑暗里， 耶和华却作我的光。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be my light.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice not over me, O my enemy; when I fall, I shall rise; when I sit in darkness, the Lord will be a light to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not rejoice over me, my enemy; When I fall, I will arise; When I sit in darkness, The Lordwillbe a light to me.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not gloat over me, my enemies! For though I fall, I will rise again. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be my light.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not rejoice over me, enemy of mine. Though I fall I will rise; Though I live in darkness, the Lord is a light for me.
verses.textEn: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be my light.

verses.textZh: 我要担当耶和华的忿怒， 因为我得罪了他， 直到他审断我的案件，为我主持公道； 他必把我领出来，到光明中去， 我就得见他的公义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要担当耶和华的忿怒， 因为我得罪了他， 直到他审断我的案件，为我主持公道； 他必把我领出来，到光明中去， 我就得见他的公义。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要忍受耶和华的恼怒； 因我得罪了他， 直等他为我辨屈，为我伸冤。 他必领我到光明中； 我必得见他的公义。
verses.textEnNiv: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the Lord ’s wrath, until he pleads my case and upholds my cause. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bear the indignation of the Lord because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my cause and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light; I shall look upon his vindication.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bear the indignation of the Lord, Because I have sinned against Him, Until He pleads my case And executes justice for me. He will bring me forth to the light; I will see His righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: I will be patient as the Lord punishes me, for I have sinned against him. But after that, he will take up my case and give me justice for all I have suffered from my enemies. The Lord will bring me into the light, and I will see his righteousness.
verses.textEnNasb: I will endure the rage of the Lord Because I have sinned against Him, Until He pleads my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me out to the light, And I will look at His righteousness.
verses.textEn: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the Lord ’s wrath, until he pleads my case and upholds my cause. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.

verses.textZh: 我的仇敌看见了， 就必蒙羞，就是那曾经对我说： "耶和华你的神在哪里"的人， 我必亲眼看见他遭报； 那时，他必被人践踏， 好象街上的泥土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的仇敌看见了， 就必蒙羞，就是那曾经对我说： "耶和华你的神在哪里"的人， 我必亲眼看见他遭报； 那时，他必被人践踏， 好象街上的泥土。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我的仇敌， 就是曾对我说「耶和华－你神在哪里」的， 他一看见这事就被羞愧遮盖。 我必亲眼见他遭报； 他必被践踏，如同街上的泥土。
verses.textEnNiv: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.
verses.textEnEsv: Then my enemy will see, and shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will look upon her; now she will be trampled down like the mire of the streets.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then shewhois my enemy will see, And shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will see her; Now she will be trampled down Like mud in the streets.
verses.textEnNlt: Then my enemies will see that the Lord is on my side. They will be ashamed that they taunted me, saying, "So where is the Lord — that God of yours?" With my own eyes I will see their downfall; they will be trampled like mud in the streets.
verses.textEnNasb: Then my enemy will see, And shame will cover her who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will look at her; At that time she will be trampled down Like mud of the streets.
verses.textEn: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, "Where is the Lord your God?" My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.

verses.textZh: 必有一天，你要重建你的城墙； 到那日，你的地界必扩展到远方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有一天，你要重建你的城墙； 到那日，你的地界必扩展到远方。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列啊，日子必到， 你的墙垣必重修； 到那日，你的境界必开展 。
verses.textEnNiv: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.
verses.textEnEsv: A day for the building of your walls! In that day the boundary shall be far extended.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the day when your walls are to be built, In that day the decree shall go far and wide.
verses.textEnNlt: In that day, Israel, your cities will be rebuilt, and your borders will be extended.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be a day for building your walls. On that day your boundary will be extended.
verses.textEn: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.

verses.textZh: 那日，必有人来归你， 从亚述到埃及， 从埃及到大河， 从这海到那海，从这山到那山，必有人来归你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日，必有人来归你， 从亚述到埃及， 从埃及到大河， 从这海到那海，从这山到那山，必有人来归你。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，人必从亚述， 从埃及的城邑， 从埃及到大河， 从这海到那海， 从这山到那山， 都归到你这里。
verses.textEnNiv: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.
verses.textEnEsv: In that day they will come to you, from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt to the River, from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day they shall come to you From Assyria and the fortified cities, From the fortress to the River, From sea to sea, And mountain to mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: People from many lands will come and honor you— from Assyria all the way to the towns of Egypt, from Egypt all the way to the Euphrates River, and from distant seas and mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: It will be a day when they will come to you From Assyria and the cities of Egypt, From Egypt even to the Euphrates River, Even from sea to sea and mountain to mountain.
verses.textEn: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

verses.textZh: 然而，大地因其中居民的缘故， 又因他们行为的恶果，必一片荒凉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，大地因其中居民的缘故， 又因他们行为的恶果，必一片荒凉。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，这地因居民的缘故， 又因他们行事的结果，必然荒凉。
verses.textEnNiv: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.
verses.textEnEsv: But the earth will be desolate because of its inhabitants, for the fruit of their deeds.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the land shall be desolate Because of those who dwell in it, And for the fruit of their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: But the land will become empty and desolate because of the wickedness of those who live there.
verses.textEnNasb: And the earth will become a wasteland because of her inhabitants, On account of the fruit of their deeds.
verses.textEn: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.

verses.textZh: 求你用你的杖牧放你的子民， 就是你产业的羊群， 他们安然独居在树林里， 在佳美的田园中； 愿他们在巴珊和基列得着牧养， 像古时一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你用你的杖牧放你的子民， 就是你产业的羊群， 他们安然独居在树林里， 在佳美的田园中； 愿他们在巴珊和基列得着牧养， 像古时一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 求耶和华在迦密山的树林中， 用你的杖牧放你独居的民， 就是你产业的羊群。 求你容他们在巴珊和基列得食物，像古时一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, who dwell alone in a forest in the midst of a garden land; let them graze in Bashan and Gilead as in the days of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shepherd Your people with Your staff, The flock of Your heritage, Who dwell solitarily in a woodland, In the midst of Carmel; Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, As in days of old.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , protect your people with your shepherd’s staff; lead your flock, your special possession. Though they live alone in a thicket on the heights of Mount Carmel, let them graze in the fertile pastures of Bashan and Gilead as they did long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: Shepherd Your people with Your scepter, The flock of Your possession Which lives by itself in the woodland, In the midst of a fruitful field. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead As in the days of old.
verses.textEn: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.

verses.textZh: 就像你从埃及地出来的时候一样， 把奇事显给我们看 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像你从埃及地出来的时候一样， 把奇事显给我们看 。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 我要把奇事显给他们看， 好像出埃及地的时候一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders."
verses.textEnEsv: As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, I will show them wonders."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," says the Lord , "I will do mighty miracles for you, like those I did when I rescued you from slavery in Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: "As in the days when you went out from the land of Egypt, I will show you miracles."
verses.textEn: "As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders."

verses.textZh: 愿万国看见， 就为自己的一切势力而惭愧； 愿他们用手掩口， 耳朵变聋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿万国看见， 就为自己的一切势力而惭愧； 愿他们用手掩口， 耳朵变聋。
verses.textZhCuv: 列国看见这事就必为自己的势力惭愧； 他们必用手捂口，掩耳不听。
verses.textEnNiv: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf.
verses.textEnEsv: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; they shall lay their hands on their mouths; their ears shall be deaf;
verses.textEnNkjv: The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; They shall put their hand over their mouth; Their ears shall be deaf.
verses.textEnNlt: All the nations of the world will stand amazed at what the Lord will do for you. They will be embarrassed at their feeble power. They will cover their mouths in silent awe, deaf to everything around them.
verses.textEnNasb: Nations will see and be ashamed Of all their might. They will put their hand on their mouth, Their ears will be deaf.
verses.textEn: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will put their hands over their mouths and their ears will become deaf.

verses.textZh: 愿他们舔土像蛇， 又像在地上腹行的动物。 愿他们战战兢兢地从他们的要塞出来， 带着惊慌的心来到耶和华我们的神那里， 因你的缘故而惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们舔土像蛇， 又像在地上腹行的动物。 愿他们战战兢兢地从他们的要塞出来， 带着惊慌的心来到耶和华我们的神那里， 因你的缘故而惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们必舔土如蛇， 又如土中腹行的物， 战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。 他们必战惧投降耶和华， 也必因我们的神而惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the Lord our God and will be afraid of you.
verses.textEnEsv: they shall lick the dust like a serpent, like the crawling things of the earth; they shall come trembling out of their strongholds; they shall turn in dread to the Lord our God, and they shall be in fear of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall lick the dust like a serpent; They shall crawl from their holes like snakes of the earth. They shall be afraid of the Lord our God, And shall fear because of You.
verses.textEnNlt: Like snakes crawling from their holes, they will come out to meet the Lord our God. They will fear him greatly, trembling in terror at his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: They will lick up dust like a snake, Like reptiles of the earth. They will come trembling out of their fortresses; To the Lord our God they will come in trepidation, And they will be afraid of You.
verses.textEn: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the Lord our God and will be afraid of you.

verses.textZh: 有何神像你，赦免罪孽， 不追究产业之余民的过犯呢？ 他不永远怀怒， 因为他喜爱怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有何神像你，赦免罪孽， 不追究产业之余民的过犯呢？ 他不永远怀怒， 因为他喜爱怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 神啊，有何神像你，赦免罪孽， 饶恕你产业之余民的罪过， 不永远怀怒，喜爱施恩？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is a God like you, pardoning iniquity and passing over transgression for the remnant of his inheritance? He does not retain his anger forever, because he delights in steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is a God like You, Pardoning iniquity And passing over the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He does not retain His anger forever, Because He delights in mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: Where is another God like you, who pardons the guilt of the remnant, overlooking the sins of his special people? You will not stay angry with your people forever, because you delight in showing unfailing love.
verses.textEnNasb: Who is a God like You, who pardons wrongdoing And passes over a rebellious act of the remnant of His possession? He does not retain His anger forever, Because He delights in mercy.
verses.textEn: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.

verses.textZh: 他必再怜爱我们， 把我们的罪孽都践踏在脚下， 又把我们 的一切罪恶都投在深海里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必再怜爱我们， 把我们的罪孽都践踏在脚下， 又把我们 的一切罪恶都投在深海里。
verses.textZhCuv: 必再怜悯我们， 将我们的罪孽踏在脚下， 又将我们的一切罪投于深海。
verses.textEnNiv: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: He will again have compassion on us; he will tread our iniquities underfoot. You will cast all our sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: He will again have compassion on us, And will subdue our iniquities. You will cast all our sins Into the depths of the sea.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again you will have compassion on us. You will trample our sins under your feet and throw them into the depths of the ocean!
verses.textEnNasb: He will again take pity on us; He will trample on our wrongdoings. Yes, You will cast all their sins Into the depths of the sea.
verses.textEn: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.

verses.textZh: 你必向雅各显诚实， 向亚伯拉罕施慈爱， 就是古时， 你起誓应许我们列祖的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必向雅各显诚实， 向亚伯拉罕施慈爱， 就是古时， 你起誓应许我们列祖的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必按古时起誓应许我们列祖的话， 向雅各发诚实， 向亚伯拉罕施慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be faithful to Jacob, and show love to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our ancestors in days long ago.
verses.textEnEsv: You will show faithfulness to Jacob and steadfast love to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
verses.textEnNkjv: You will give truth to Jacob And mercy to Abraham, Which You have sworn to our fathers From days of old.
verses.textEnNlt: You will show us your faithfulness and unfailing love as you promised to our ancestors Abraham and Jacob long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: You will give truth to Jacob And favor to Abraham, Which You swore to our forefathers From the days of old.
verses.textEn: You will be faithful to Jacob, and show love to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our ancestors in days long ago.
